description: This plot illustrates the Average Correct Gate Rate across different Embedding Layers for four distinct input configurations. The x-axis, labeled "Embedding Layer," uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 31, with numeric tick marks spaced at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Average Correct Gate Rate," employs a linear scale ranging from 0.2 to 1.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The plot contains four lines, all without markers and surrounded by lightly shaded regions. The "Character Attention input" is depicted by a solid light blue line; it begins at approximately 0.1 at x=0, rises sharply to a peak of roughly 0.81 at x=4, declines to a trough of 0.25 at x=12, and subsequently rises with fluctuations to end at approximately 0.73 at x=31. The "Character MLP input" is shown as a dashed light blue line, starting at 0.83 at x=0, peaking at 0.93 at x=3, declining to 0.53 at x=12, rising to a plateau near 0.92 between x=18 and x=28, and ending at 0.82 at x=31. The "Wiki Attention input" is represented by a solid dark red line, starting at 0.2 at x=0, rising to a peak of 0.8 at x=5, declining to a trough of 0.37 at x=13, and rising with fluctuations to finish at 0.69 at x=31. Finally, the "Wiki MLP input" is a dashed dark red line that begins at 0.82 at x=0, peaks at 0.88 at x=3, declines to 0.6 at x=12, rises to a steady trend around 0.87 between x=18 and x=28, and concludes at 0.85 at x=31.
